name: Guillered
source:
Capable of traveling between worlds, Guillered is the one who created Laughter Land and is responsible for bringing all the boys there. Although his exact intentions are left to speculation, he attests that his purpose is only for the happiness of everyone. At least, his sweet, playful demeanor does seem entirely genuine, and his kindness is far from suspicious.

[Edited from [url=https://eroderekko.wordpress.com/2013/06/11/laughter-land-first-impressions-trial/]Eroderekko's blog[/url]]

His gem is located on his left hand.

[spoiler]He is the older brother of Dag and Meg, Dick's grandmother. He started Laughter Land after he and his siblings were ostracised after being rescued from their mother's cult.[/spoiler]
